title: Unmounted spawn work has zero extra game frames

verification.actor: The unmounted player and the existing FOLLOWER Mankey from test.sav.
verification.trigger: Use the sealed 673-step Route 30 and Cherrygrove route that previously produced the spawn-linked hitch.
verification.observable: After the fixed Cherrygrove anchor, read every stock main-loop return. Fail if one update uses more than two native cycles, advances more than two scheduler frames, exceeds the bounded two-cycle clock margin, or holds the player render position during active travel. Bind the current Mankey profile and require one explicit destination scan within 21 frames.
limits: Route 30 travel and the map seam are warm-up. The strict zero-stutter window starts at Cherrygrove (565,398), after the seam has completed.
The strict window contains at least 2600 continuous frames and 1800 moving frames.
At least one normal destination search and finalizer must join on attempt, finalization, slot, and map identity. A no-spawn-work route cannot pass.

The saved Mankey's source-bound base profile must supply hopPause 5 and hopMaxDistance 6. Terrain can select a conditional profile during the route; Movement scenarios own separate Hop and chain timing checks.
One explicit destination attempt must finish in at most 21 frames. Population-count behavior remains in the separate D5 population scenarios.
The result uses melonDS scheduler and native-cycle memory data. Screenshots, video, host CPU time, and human judgement are not proof.
Any missing pacing sample fails. One extra game frame fails. There is no allowed hitch count.
Prepared setup does not earn movement or pacing credit. The source save is not changed.

events.value: Load the save without changes and bind its existing Mankey follower at the fixed Route 30 start.
Follow the sealed route into Cherrygrove and around the fixed rectangle until step 673.
Require continuous two-cycle main-loop pacing, the current Mankey profile binding, and normal 21-frame destination work after the Cherrygrove anchor.

stop.condition: Step 673 is settled with at least 2600 strict pacing frames, 1800 moving frames, the current Mankey profile binding, natural spawn work, and zero late updates

invariants: The current follower remains the save's existing Mankey
The source-bound base profile remains verified for the same Mankey follower while terrain can select conditional profile fingerprints
Every strict pacing interval uses at most two native cycles
Joined normal spawn search/finalizer work occurs during the strict window
An explicit destination scan completes within 21 frames
